title: fix(ui): the OWD overview's draft save goes through the draft guard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPfubuppK8n7Eq4Z3kP7sCC)_

Fixes #37515

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio「访问 → 记录共享基线总览」点保存时，若别人（助手、另一位管理员、另一个标签页）在页面打开后改过或新建了该对象的草稿，现在会弹出冲突提示（重新加载／确认后覆盖／继续编辑），不再悄悄覆盖，也不再把管理员没看到的草稿一起发布上线。
- 接着「共享默认值两次保存后写覆盖前写」那张卡（已合并）：上次给发布加了版本校验，这次把发布前的草稿写入也纳入同一套校验。
- 碰到冲突的人只会多看到一个对话框，选「继续编辑」什么都不写；本改动只在界面层，可直接回退。
- 无。

## What changes

`PackageOwdOverviewPanel` (the package-wide org-wide sharing default overview) wrote each changed row's draft with a plain `client.save`: a whole-document PUT over a read taken at Save time, with no precondition. The publish after it was already pinned (#36962), but the live row does not move in either race below, so that pin caught neither:

1. a draft another writer saved after the read was replaced entirely;
2. a draft that appeared after the page loaded was picked up by the Save-time re-read and published live with the row, without the "unpublished draft" mark ever being shown.

Now the draft write goes through the same guard the Studio editors use since #36726:

- **The load reads each row's draft with `readDraftForSave`** at the package the save writes (`?package=`; the old read named no package, whose answer pins nothing for a package-scoped save). Its pin, the draft body it served and the published pin are the row's basis (`RowBasis`).
- **The Save writes the edit over the basis**, through `guard.save`, pinned to it: `If-Match` the load's draft version, or `If-None-Match: *` when the load read none. A draft written since, or one that appeared after the load, is refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` and the #36601 dialog asks (reload, overwrite after a confirmation, keep editing). A row with no pending draft still takes its published baseline from a Save-time `/layers` read, which the publish pin holds.
- **`editPinsRef` holds the whole basis, keyed by package + name**, is rebuilt by each installed load from its own rows (a kept edit keeps the basis it was made on), follows the draft the Save wrote (receipt pin, or no draft once a refused publish took it back), and drops the row's entry once its publish lands (the guard then holds the publish receipt, and nothing stale is re-sent over it).
- **Loads are sequenced**: only the last load started installs rows and pins. A superseded load installs nothing, and a superseded kept-edit re-read puts no edit back (the later load reset the table, as a plain load does).
- **A draft read refused `403`** (a draft this session may not read) is no longer read as "no draft": the Save refuses that row with the existing "draft you are not allowed to read" text instead of writing a body seeded from the published layer over it.

### Small decisions taken here (listed per the dev-thread rule)

- A row whose load read a pending draft saves over **that** draft body, not a Save-time re-read: the dialog's "overwrite" says "your version will replace the saved draft", and only the load's body is the author's version.
- A row whose load draft read failed (no answer, no pin) keeps the old Save-time read, now pinned to that read: a draft that appeared before that read cannot be told apart there, and refusing the row would turn a transient read error into a refused Save.
- N2 (a saved row whose `/layers` read failed publishes unpinned) is **kept as is**. It is the convention every Studio editor shares (`readPublishedPin` answers no pin for a failed read), so changing it for this one surface would fork that convention, and refusing the publish changes shipped behaviour, which is not a dev-thread call. The draft half is now guarded whatever the `/layers` read did.

## Tests

New file `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.draftPinned-37515.test.tsx`, a server double whose draft door enforces `If-Match` / `If-None-Match: *` and whose refusals are parsed by the real `MetadataClient`:

- draft replaced: a pending draft re-saved elsewhere after the load is refused, nothing written or published; the same for a draft written inside the Save's own window (after its `/layers` read); "overwrite" asks again, re-sends pinned to the refusal's `currentVersion`, and publishes the author's version;
- draft appeared after load: the save asserts none, is refused, nothing goes live and the other writer's draft is not taken back; "reload" shows it under the unpublished-draft mark, and the next Save, made over it, goes live;
- controls: the draft is read at the package and each save is pinned to its load and lands with no dialog; one editor saving one row twice never conflicts with itself; a server whose draft read serves no `version` gets an unpinned save, as before;
- kept edit: a row refused at its draft save keeps its edit over the re-read and stays pinned to its load;
- sequencing: a plain load finishing before the kept-edit re-read it overlapped does not re-pin the kept edit.

`PackageOwdOverviewPanel.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` pins the exact save options; its expectation now includes `ifNoneMatch: '*'` (those rows load with no draft).

<details><summary>Suite and ablations (at f0bb20d4 for the suite; ablations on the committed fix 7b0a3b7a, each restored to HEAD by `ablation-replace`)</summary>

- All 13 `PackageOwdOverviewPanel*` test files: 70 passed.
- A1, the draft pin not sent (`recordRead(..., basis.draft)` changed to `null`): 8 of the 9 new non-sequencing tests red (every race and pin assertion); the no-`version` control and the sequencing test stay green, as expected.
- A2, sequencing removed (`if (!current()) return false;` deleted): the sequencing test red, 20 others green.
- A3, a kept edit not keeping its basis (`prior` forced `undefined`): 4 red (the new kept-edit and sequencing tests, and two #36962 kept-edit tests).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not filed (read only, not measured): when the Save-time `/layers` read of a row with no pending draft fails, the draft is built on an empty baseline, as before this PR. The draft door's destructive-change guard is expected to refuse such a body for an object with fields; nothing here changes that path.
- A pending draft that a refused publish could not take back (its discard failed) stays the row's basis at the Save's receipt version, so the next Save of that row is not refused by its own write.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.draftPinned-37515.test.tsx` (expect 10 passed).

Read first, by risk: the `doSave` loop in `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` (basis selection, guarded save, basis updates after the save and the publish); then `load` (sequencing and basis rebuild); then `readObjectBodies` / `draftBasisOf`.

<details><summary>Local gates (at f0bb20d4)</summary>

- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, 0 errors.
- eslint on the three touched source/test files: 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings on untouched lines).
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived list: all 38 derived families exit 0 (27 on the code tree at 7b0a3b7a before the changeset commit, the 11 changeset families the changeset added at f0bb20d4); `--ran` reconciles 38 of 38

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (touched files; repo-wide lint is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
